newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia president asks former premier to form govt.
newsitem.headline: Latvia president asks former premier to form govt.

text.p: Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis on Wednesday asked former prime minister Andris Shkele, who resigned last week, to form a new government.
"I have been invited by the president to form a new government," Shkele told reporters after meeting Ulmanis for more than an hour.

Shkele resigned in fury last week after Ulmanis called on parliament to reject a new finance minister backed by Shkele and the leading government party who had been investigated by the prosecutor's office.
Ulmanis and Shkele later resolved their differences and the finance minister himself resigned only days after his appointment.
Shkele, who has pledged to speed the reforms launched after Latvia quit the former Soviet Union in 1991, said the formation of a new government would be tough.
Shkele's former administration was an eight-party coalition which came to power at the end of 1995.
